verdict.rationale: The evidence shows UK EMI expertise on the incentives page and free jurisdiction-specific founder resources (UK and DE cap table versions). This shows some market-specific orientation, but these are service descriptions and templates rather than published guidance on local startup instruments. Missing for 10: published content on German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules and French BSPCE; actual articles or guides explaining the EMI scheme rather than a service listing; independent corroboration of the firm's thought-leadership output.
